ticker_news.title: Nasdaq 100: Tech Stocks Back in Focus After Nvidia’s Blowout Numbers
ticker_news.description: Nvidia's strong earnings report boosted tech stock sentiment, with the company delivering a robust revenue forecast. However, market analysts remain cautious due to broader economic concerns like rising bond yields, potential AI technology bubble, and macroeconomic uncertainties.
ticker_news.author: Fawad Razaqzada

ticker_news.title: Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Market Size to Hit USD 54.24 Billion by 2032 | Research by SNS Insider
ticker_news.description: The Battery Energy Storage System market is projected to grow from USD 8.23 Billion in 2024 to USD 54.34 Billion by 2032, driven by renewable energy integration, grid modernization, and increasing demand for reliable backup power.
